source_excerpts.text:
## 2. Four real readings acquire each complex return

A passive 50:50 combiner with reference amplitude `R>0` gives one detector power

\[
I_\theta(z,u)=\tfrac12|h_z(u)+R e^{i\theta}|^2,
\quad\theta\in\{0,\pi/2,\pi,3\pi/2\}.
\]

The complex return is acquired by

\[
\widehat h_z=\frac{(\widehat I_0-\widehat I_\pi)
+i(\widehat I_{\pi/2}-\widehat I_{3\pi/2})}{2R}.
\]

Simultaneous error `eta` in each physical detector power implies `|hhat-h|<=sqrt(2) eta/R`. A fixed detector offset cancels; a changing offset does not. Four readings per load give **twelve raw readings per target-power query**. A balanced two-detector implementation uses two reference phases but still four scalar readings per load.

The maximum physical detector power is `(1+R)^2/2`, and the reference consumes energy `R^2` per unit probe energy per exposure. Reference power, shot noise, phase stabilization, dynamic range and combining loss are charged. An arbitrarily strong unpriced local oscillator is not an allowed precision oracle.

## A. Reciprocal collection and actual acquired information

For a fixed reciprocal passive source, a reciprocal launcher with forward U
and reverse transpose U^T returns u^T T_z u through its driven feed. Its target
residue is (t^T u)^2, whose magnitude equals matched-target power. The Schur
complement of the hidden load yields T_z=S0+z tt^T/(1-sz); |s|<=1 and |z|<1
make the denominator nonzero. A fixed reciprocal lossy front end can be reduced
to a passive reciprocal two-port for each configuration. This per-configuration
identity does not prove that arbitrary changing front ends share one fixed Gram.
Control needs an actual fixed calibrated linear command map and source.

Expanding half-combined powers gives I0-Ipi=2R Re h and
Ipi/2-I3pi/2=2R Im h. Four absolute errors bounded by eta give independent
quadrature bounds eta/R and hence field error sqrt(2)eta/R. Twelve powers
acquire the three fields. These are additional interference observations;
intensity-only square-root lower bounds retain their original scope. Reference
power, combiner loss, detector dynamic range and all calibration are charged.

statement: For I_theta=|h+R exp(i theta)|^2/2 at four quadratures,R>0,opposite differences divided by2R recover h. Simultaneous absolute power errors eta give field error<=sqrt(2)eta/R. Three target states cost twelve scalar powers.
